**YTL Power Shares Under Scrutiny Amid Nvidia Turmoil**
YTL Power International shares stabilized on Monday following their worst weekly selloff in nearly two years. The pressure stems from turmoil surrounding Nvidia Corp. and allegations that the Malaysian utility has links to Chinese-connected firms, casting a shadow over its artificial intelligence business.
